title: Base SendUnitData variant 7
purpose: Add a structurally distinct model-prior seed rather than a cosmetic byte variant.
expected_behavior: A plausible target processes the SendUnitData envelope, interprets the connection address and sequence fields, and either routes the contained connected explicit request or rejects it cleanly if connection state is absent.
constraints_preserved: Uses little-endian encapsulation length 001e matching the 30-byte SendUnitData payload.
Includes zero interface handle and timeout fields before CPF items.
Uses two CPF items with internally consistent item lengths for address and connected-data content.
Maintains a single structurally distinct single_request seed rather than a cosmetic variant.
issue_safety_notes: No external issue knowledge is available. This seed is a model-prior connected-message variant for coverage diversity and does not rely on any verified vulnerability or externally confirmed protocol detail.
